headline: No scored news; lines hold steady
body: A quiet day with no scored events. The board barely moved: Gatekeeper and Reversion each slipped by a hundredth of a point as earlier announcements continued to fade from the record, which is how the index slowly lets old news go. Horizon Balance stays at 1.9, unchanged from yesterday.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Gatekeeper and Reversion drifted slightly lower (-0.0) as older news faded.
